title: fix: give code agent isolates headroom on CPU and subrequest limits
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Raises the Workers for Platforms per-invocation limits for code agent isolates from `cpuMs: 1000, subRequests: 32` to `cpuMs: 5000, subRequests: 64`.
- An agent with every hosted MCP server, the default eight steps and sixteen tool calls already makes about 30 subrequests, so the old cap left no headroom.
- CPU time excludes waiting on model and MCP responses; 5 s still stops runaway code.
- One-line change in `gen/src/text/agents/code-client.ts` plus the matching test expectation.

gist.headline: More room in the hive
gist.blurb: The code agent isolate got a larger lunchbox: 5 seconds of CPU and 64 subrequests per invocation. Hosted MCP servers can now all come along without immediately eating the budget.
gist.summary: Raised code-agent isolate limits in gen.pollinations.ai from 1,000 ms to 5,000 ms of CPU time and from 32 to 64 subrequests per invocation, giving default eight-step agents using hosted MCP tools practical headroom.
gist.impact: Code agents can now complete more tool-heavy runs—especially with every hosted MCP server enabled—while the 5-second CPU cap still keeps runaway code contained.
